<title level="1" right="Spell 5" pfs="Standard">
[Howling Blizzard](/Spells.aspx?ID=1559)
<actions string="Two Actions or Three Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Air" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=5" />
<trait label="Cold" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=27" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 335

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

**Deities**
[Alglenweis](/Deities.aspx?ID=171), [Kostchtchie](/Deities.aspx?ID=77)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Area** varies

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Defense**
Reflex

</row>

</column>

---

Freezing winds extend from your hands, pushing away from you with great force. If you Cast this Spell with 2 actions, it has an area of a 60-foot cone; if you Cast this Spell with 3 actions, it has a range of 500 feet and an area of a 30-foot burst. Each creature in the area takes 10d6 cold damage with a basic Reflex save. Snowdrifts and icy gales fill the area until the start of your next turn, making the area difficult terrain.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 2d6.
name: Howling Blizzard
